prompts.hub: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one blank location-title plaque PNG for a gothic science-fiction game's Precipice expedition hub. Hand-painted inked illustration matching the supplied reference's dark iron and weathered antique brass, NOT photorealistic. Compact landscape plaque, width to height about 1.6:1. Solid charcoal slightly teal recessed central panel, generous clean empty area for three lines of live UI text. Thick asymmetrical angular iron perimeter, restrained brass edging, rivets, small bronze winged skull ornament at the top center, industrial docking authority feel. This is a location sign, not a button. Flat front-facing view. Entire silhouette inside canvas, tightly framed with a little transparent margin. No writing, no glyphs in central panel, no ribbons, no background. Genuine transparent alpha outside the plaque.
prompts.chart: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one blank expedition-chart title plaque PNG for a gothic science-fiction game's map on a dock foreman's table. Hand-painted inked illustration matching supplied reference dark iron and aged brass, NOT photorealistic. Wide horizontal plate, width to height about 2.8:1. Large empty dark teal-charcoal enamel center for two lines of live UI text. Heavy worn iron corners with brass tabs and bolts, small engraved compass-like ornament confined to extreme left trim. Mild scratches only, clean readable center. Industrial expedition cartography instrument tag, distinct from clickable buttons. Flat front-facing view, no perspective skew. Entire silhouette inside canvas, tightly framed with small transparent margin. No writing, no lettering, no symbols in center, no cloth ribbons, no background. Genuine transparent alpha outside the plaque.
